import re, json

def getr(file,sheet):
    o=tables[file][sheet]
    return o.get('rows',[]) if isinstance(o,dict) else o.rows
recs=[]
for page in ['page18','page19','page20']:
    for ri,row in enumerate(getr('mmc1.pdf',page),1):
        # identify organoid row: C2 organoid ID
        if len(row)>1 and re.fullmatch(r'P-\d+-[A-Z0-9]+', str(row[1].get('value',''))):
            vals=[]
            for c in row:
                vals.append((c.get('ref'), str(c.get('value','')), c.get('x0')))
            # columns by x: regimen ~453, ic50 ~534, response ~568, consistency ~603
            regimen=next((v for r,v,x in vals if 445<x<470), '')
            ic=next((v for r,v,x in vals if 525<x<545), '')
            resp=next((v for r,v,x in vals if 560<x<580), '')
            cons=next((v for r,v,x in vals if 595<x<615), '')
            recs.append((page,ri,row[0]['value'],row[1]['value'],regimen,ic,resp,cons))
print(len(recs))
